title_en: Traditions & Gardens of Japan
subtitle_en: Budget-Friendly Travel in Tokyo, Kanazawa & Kyoto
description_en: Discover Japan's cultural depth on this 7-day self-guided tour through three captivating cities. Begin in vibrant Tokyo, then travel to Kanazawa—a beautifully preserved castle town that offers a more relaxed pace than Japan's busiest destinations. Home to Kenroku-en (one of Japan's top three gardens), atmospheric geisha districts, and exceptional seafood, Kanazawa provides an authentic window into Edo-period elegance. Your journey concludes in Kyoto, where ancient temples and traditional streetscapes await. With Shinkansen tickets, comfortable hotels, and luggage delivery included, travel light and explore freely—no fixed schedules, just your own path through Japan's rich traditions and stunning gardens.

title_en: Historic Towns & Mountain Heritage
subtitle_en: Budget-Friendly Travel in Tokyo, Takayama & Kyoto
description_en: Experience the best of Japan at an unbeatable value. This 7-day self-guided tour takes you through Japan's most captivating destinations—Tokyo, Takayama, Shirakawa-go, and Kyoto—with Shinkansen tickets, hotel stays, and luggage delivery all included. Start in Tokyo, where ancient temples meet neon-lit streets. Then journey into the Japanese Alps to Takayama, a beautifully preserved Edo-period town famous for its wooden streetscapes and melt-in-your-mouth Hida beef. From there, visit the UNESCO World Heritage village of Shirakawa-go, where traditional thatched-roof farmhouses stand against a breathtaking mountain backdrop. Finally, explore Kyoto, the cultural heart of Japan, with its iconic temples, bamboo groves, and atmospheric geisha districts. With all major logistics taken care of, you're free to explore at your own pace—no rigid schedules, no group tours. Just you, Japan, and the freedom to discover.

title_en: From Tokyo to Kyushu Journey
subtitle_en: Budget-Friendly Travel in Tokyo, Hiroshima & Fukuoka
description_en: Experience the best of Japan at an exceptional value. This 7-day self-guided tour takes you through three of Japan’s most exciting cities—Tokyo, Hiroshima, and Fukuoka—with Shinkansen tickets, hotel accommodation, and luggage delivery service included for a smooth and comfortable journey. Begin your trip in Tokyo, where traditional temples and modern skyscrapers stand side by side. Travel by bullet train to Hiroshima, with optional sightseeing opportunities along the way such as Himeji Castle, Hiroshima’s historic sites, and a visit to Miyajima Island to see its famous floating torii gate. With major travel arrangements already taken care of, this tour allows you to explore Japan at your own pace—perfect for independent travelers seeking a stress-free and flexible Japan experience.

Stay at Mount Fuji-view hotels, practice tea ceremony at historic tea houses, and explore castle towns where artisan traditions thrive. day_by_day.activities: Breakfast at hotel. After checkout, taxi to Seki to explore Japan's sword culture. Seki developed as a renowned blade-making town, while nearby Sekigahara witnessed the historic battle that changed Japan 400 years ago. day_by_day.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel Hotel Check-out In the morning, travel from Nagoya to Toba by Sightseeing Limited Express "SHIMAKAZE" or another limited express train. Toba is a port town in Mie Prefecture. It is known for its beautiful sea and island views and for its Ama diving culture. From Toba, take the shuttle bus to Hachiman Kamado. day_by_day.title: Let's explore beyond Kyoto!
day_by_day.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel Ready to explore beyond Kyoto? Here are some great spots to check out: Osaka is the place to go. Shop at Osaka's foremost shopping districts Dotonbori and Tsutenkaku Tower and indulge in takoyaki and okonomiyaki until your heart's content! Nara is the place to be. Nara predates Kyoto as an ancient capital, and its UNESCO World Heritage Sites — Todaiji Temple, Kasuga Taisha Shrine, and Kofukuji Temple — are just some of many spots with a rich and immersive history. Nara Park also provides a unique experience where feeding the gentle deer offers a moment to connect with nature.

Naoshima Island features museums and outdoor artworks, making it great for walking and exploring. Reserve a rental bicycle in advance to get around easily.

day_by_day.title: Toba's Ama diving culture and the delicious seafood
day_by_day.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel Hotel Check-out In the morning, travel from Nagoya to Toba by Sightseeing Limited Express "SHIMAKAZE" or limited express train. Toba is a port town in Mie Prefecture. It is known for its beautiful sea and island views and for its Ama diving culture. From Toba, take the shuttle bus to Hachiman Kamado. Hachiman Kamado is an Ama hut where you can enjoy a meal while Ama divers share stories about their fishing experiences and lives. You will enjoy delicious Ise seafood for lunch! After lunch, take the shuttle bus back to Toba, then travel from Toba to Kashikojima by limited express train. Hotel Check-in Dinner at the Hotel

day_by_day.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel In the morning, travel from Nankai Naｍba to Gokurakubashi by limited express train, and then transfer to Koyasan by cable car. Koyasan is a mountain town recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is surrounded by cedar forests and has deep ties to Japanese Buddhism. Kobo Daishi Kukai practiced asceticism here for over 1,200 years. In the evening, return to Nankai Namba by cable car and limited express train.

title_en: Spirit of Tradition: Shirakawa-go – Deluxe
subtitle_en: Golden Route Plus: Shirakawa-go,Miyajima & Nara Hotel  Deluxe
description_en: Enjoy the highlights of destinations in Japan! Tokyo, with its cutting-edge urban culture; Hakone, where you can relax in a hot spring with a spectacular view of Mt. Fuji; Takayama, with its old Japanese townscape; Kyoto, where you can feel the seasonal beauty of the city; Nara, the ancient capital of Japan with its mythology and Buddhism; and Hiroshima, where the importance of peace is discussed. On this tour, visitors can experience the traditions of Japan, where the experience of nature and history are in harmony, all at once. The tour will take you to all the popular tourist destinations, allowing you to fully experience the various ways of Japan. Enjoy the comfort of travel on the Shinkansen and express trains.

title_en: Discover Hokkaido:  Nature & Scenic Views
subtitle_en: Explore Hokkaido's Untamed Beauty in Comfort
description_en: Discover Hokkaido's majestic nature on this comprehensive tour. From Sapporo and Otaru city walks to iconic attractions like Asahiyama Zoo and Shiretoko Five Lakes, experience dramatic mountain vistas at Sounkyo and serene wilderness at Lake Akan. The perfect blend of urban charm and pristine natural beauty.

day_by_day.title: Welcome to Japan- Arrival in Hokkaido
day_by_day.activities: Welcome to Japan! Our staff awaits you at New Chitose Airport with everything needed for your journey. Enjoy a comfortable chartered taxi transfer to your hotel for check-in.

day_by_day.title: A day exploring Sapporo and the charm of Otaru
day_by_day.activities: Hotel breakfast Spend a full day exploring vibrant Sapporo, renowned for its spacious urban layout, abundant nature, and exceptional Hokkaido cuisine. Must-visit attractions include Odori Park, the city's central green space hosting seasonal festivals and offering stunning cityscapes; Susukino, Sapporo's largest entertainment district perfect for experiencing local nightlife and gourmet dining; and the iconic Sapporo Clock Tower, a historic landmark showcasing Hokkaido's pioneering heritage. (*Entrance fees not included) Consider extending your adventure to picturesque Otaru, a charming historic port town featuring preserved stone warehouses and romantic canals. Highlights include the famous Otaru Canal with its nostalgic stone buildings, Kitaichi Glass for exquisite handcrafted glassware, the enchanting Music Box Museum, and Sankaku Market for the freshest seafood experiences.

day_by_day.title: Wildlife encounters and scenic wonders in Sounkyo Gorge
day_by_day.activities: Enjoy the Hotel breakfast and checkout. Travel by chartered taxi to Asahikawa visiting Asahiyama Zoo, Hokkaido's premier wildlife park for observing natural animal behaviors up close. (*Entrance fees not included) Continue to Sounkyo Gorge in Daisetsuzan National Park, featuring dramatic cliffs, waterfalls, and seasonal landscapes. Witness the contrasting Ginga and Ryusei Falls, Sounkyo's iconic twin waterfalls offering breathtaking scenery. Transfer to hotel via chartered taxi for check-in and dinner.

day_by_day.title: A scenic journey through peaks, lakes, and open skies
day_by_day.activities: Enjoy the Hotel breakfast and checkout. Take chartered taxi to Kurodake Ropeway, ascending through spectacular gorge and forest views via cable car and chairlift for breathtaking mountain panoramas. (*Entrance fees not included) Enjoy free lunch in Kitami, then continue to Bihoro Pass, offering stunning overlook views of Lake Kussharo, one of Hokkaido's most iconic scenic spots. Explore Japan's largest caldera lake, where vast tranquil waters and surrounding wilderness create serene natural beauty. Return to hotel via chartered taxi for check-in and dinner.

day_by_day.title: Discovering the untamed beauty of Shiretoko and Lake Mashu
day_by_day.activities: Hotel breakfast Journey by chartered taxi to Shiretoko, a UNESCO World Heritage site at Hokkaido's northeastern tip, renowned for pristine wilderness, diverse wildlife, and spectacular landscapes. Key destinations include: Shiretoko Five Lakes, featuring pristine forests, serene lakes, and mountain views accessible via elevated boardwalks; Shiretoko Nature Center for wildlife education and recommended lunch spot; and Shiretoko Pass, one of the "Eight Views of Shiretoko," offering magnificent vistas of Mount Rausu and dramatic mountain scenery. Return to hotel via chartered taxi for dinner.

day_by_day.title: Relaxing moments by the peaceful shores of Lake Akan
day_by_day.activities: Hotel breakfast Enjoy free time exploring Lake Akan area, where rich natural beauty meets indigenous Ainu culture. Experience the serene Lake Akan cruise offering stunning views of Mount O-Akan and pristine lakeside scenery. Visit Ainu Kotan village to discover traditional culture, crafts, and performances in authentic shops and theaters. Stroll the Bokke Nature Trail through forests to witness fascinating mud volcanoes created by geothermal activity.(*Entrance fees not included) Perfect blend of natural wonders and cultural heritage. Hotel dinner

title_en: Scenic Southern Hokkaido Escape: Hot Springs & History
subtitle_en: Explore Hokkaido's Untamed Beauty in Comfort
description_en: Experience the perfect blend of urban charm, indigenous culture, and stunning landscapes. Begin with delightful city walks through Sapporo and Otaru, then immerse yourself in Ainu cultural sites, volcanic hot spring resorts, and captivating historical theme parks.　Relax by the magnificent shores of Lake Toya, savoring breathtaking lakeside vistas and tranquil moments. Conclude your journey in historic Hakodate, exploring the vibrant morning market and witnessing the spectacular night views from Mount Hakodate.　This thoughtfully balanced itinerary combine urban exploration, natural wonders, and cultural discovery—ideal for first-time visitors to Hokkaido.

day_by_day.title: Welcome to Japan- Arrival in Hokkaido
day_by_day.activities: Welcome to Japan! Our staff awaits you at New Chitose Airport with everything needed for your journey. Enjoy a comfortable chartered taxi transfer to your hotel for check-in.

day_by_day.title: A day exploring Sapporo and the charm of Otaru
day_by_day.activities: After a breakfast served at the hotel, spend a full day exploring vibrant Sapporo, renowned for its spacious urban layout, abundant nature, and exceptional Hokkaido cuisine. Must-visit attractions include Odori Park, the city's central green space hosting seasonal festivals and offering stunning cityscapes; Susukino, Sapporo's largest entertainment district perfect for experiencing local nightlife and gourmet dining; and the iconic Sapporo Clock Tower, a historic landmark showcasing Hokkaido's pioneering heritage.(*Entrance fees not included) Consider extending your adventure to picturesque Otaru, a charming historic port town featuring preserved stone warehouses and romantic canals. Highlights include the famous Otaru Canal with its nostalgic stone buildings, Kitaichi Glass for exquisite handcrafted glassware, the enchanting Music Box Museum, and Sankaku Market for the freshest seafood experiences.

day_by_day.title: A journey through Ainu culture and volcanic landscapes
day_by_day.activities: Hotel breakfast and checkout. Send large luggage ahead to Hakodate for hassle-free sightseeing in Lake Toya. Full-day chartered taxi tour exploring: UPOPOY National Ainu Museum and Park for immersive cultural experiences with traditional dance and crafts; Noboribetsu Date Jidaimura, an Edo-period theme park featuring ninja performances and samurai atmosphere; dramatic Noboribetsu Hell Valley with volcanic steam vents showcasing Earth's raw power; and Showa-Shinzan Bear Ranch for close encounters with Hokkaido's iconic brown bears. (*Entrance fees not included) Transfer to hotel via chartered taxi for check-in and dinner.

day_by_day.title: Relaxing by the tranquil waters of Lake Toya
day_by_day.activities: After breakfast at the hotel, enjoy a leisurely day exploring Lake Toya area, Hokkaido's premier caldera lake destination renowned for stunning mountain-lake vistas and rejuvenating hot springs amid pristine natural surroundings. Recommended highlights include: Lake Toya cruise offering tranquil views of Nakajima Island and surrounding peaks from the water; Mount Usu Ropeway ascending to panoramic viewpoints overlooking the lake and dramatic volcanic landscape; and Silo Observatory, a popular scenic spot providing breathtaking views of Lake Toya and its central island and complete the day with a Hotel dinner (Entrance fees not included).

day_by_day.title: Strolling through Hakodate’s bay district and sparkling night views
day_by_day.activities: Breakfast served at the hotel and checkout. Travel by bus to Toya Station, then take a JR Limited Express train to Hakodate Station. Discover Hakodate, southern Hokkaido's charming port city celebrated for stunning ocean vistas, historic streetscapes, and exceptional fresh seafood. Must-visit attractions include: Kanemori Red Brick Warehouses, beautifully preserved historical buildings now housing delightful shops and cafes; scenic Bay Area strolls along the harbor showcasing Hakodate's nostalgic maritime charm; Hachiman-zaka slope offering iconic city views stretching toward the sea; and Mount Hakodate's world-renowned night panorama accessible via ropeway, considered among Japan's most spectacular evening vistas. (*Entrance fees not included) Hotel check-in

day_by_day.title: The flavors and views of Hakodate at your own pace
day_by_day.activities: Hotel breakfast and continue exploring Hakodate's captivating attractions: Hakodate Morning Market - Experience vibrant seafood culture with the freshest catches and authentic Hokkaido delicacies at this bustling marketplace. Goryokaku Park - Discover Japan's unique star-shaped fortress ruins offering historical insights and seasonal beauty. Ascend Goryokaku Tower for spectacular aerial views of the distinctive pentagonal layout and panoramic city vistas. Motomachi District - Stroll charming hillside streets lined with historic churches and elegant Western-style mansions, immersing yourself in Hakodate's rich cultural heritage and architectural treasures from the Meiji era. (*Entrance fees not included)

title_en: Kansai Essentials: Osaka, Nara, and Kyoto
subtitle_en: Discover Japan from Osaka
description_en: This classic itinerary is an excellent choice for first-time visitors to Japan, taking you through three of Kansai's most iconic cities. Discover the vibrant energy of Osaka, the timeless history of Nara, and the world-renowned cultural heritage of Kyoto, with the freedom to explore each destination at your own pace. Enjoy sightseeing, local cuisine, and shopping while immersing yourself in the unique atmosphere of each city. From ancient traditions and historic landmarks to lively urban districts, experience the rich diversity that makes the Kansai region so captivating. Even on a shorter trip, this journey offers a well-balanced introduction to both Japan's traditional culture and modern lifestyle.

title_en: From Sacred Mountains to Coastal Calm
subtitle_en: Faith & Tradition: Koyasan, Ise-Shima & Shirakawa-go Hotel Standard: Departures from April to November
description_en:
The journey begins with Tokyo's vibrant cityscape. Then it continues to Kashikojima, a coastal area surrounded by the sea, where you can experience the gentle nature of Ise-Shima and savor fresh seafood.
In Kyoto and Nara, you will visit temples and shrines steeped in a thousand years of history, allowing you to experience a moment of connection with Japan's spiritual culture.
The highlight of the journey is Koyasan. Surrounded by lush green mountains, this sacred site offers a space filled with silence and prayer, where you can slowly calm your mind. Staying at the hotel and enjoying vegetarian cuisine, you will experience a time unlike your daily life.
Afterwards, you will enjoy the bustling atmosphere of Osaka and the traditional townscape of Takayama, and the journey will return to a rhythm that harmonizes with nature and human life. The balance of stillness and movement that lingers in your heart is the essence of this journey.

title_en: A Journey of Culture, Peace, and Spiritual Reflection
subtitle_en: Faith & Tradition: Koyasan,Miyajima & Shirakawa-go Hotel Standard: Departures from April to November
description_en:
Beginning with the modern glamour of Tokyo, you will experience a quiet sense of emotion as you encounter prayers for peace in Hiroshima.
After experiencing the lively food culture and warm hospitality of Osaka, you will head to Koyasan, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, nestled deep in the mountains.
At Koyasan, you will encounter solemn temples and moss-covered Okunoin, where you can find peace of mind. In this sacred space, far removed from everyday life, you can immerse yourself in the "time of prayer" that the Japanese people have cherished.
As the journey continues to Kyoto and Takayama, you will experience the beauty of Japan's traditions and the wisdom of living in harmony with nature, further deepening the tranquility of the trip.
This is a journey that blends modernity and tradition, bustling energy and tranquility, leaving a lasting sense of peace in your heart.

title_en: Koyasan: Sacred Sites and Quiet Beauty
subtitle_en: Faith & Tradition: Koyasan 2nights & Shirakawa-go Hotel Standard: Departures from April to November
description_en:
After kicking off your journey in Tokyo, head away from the hustle and bustle to Koyasan, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, a sacred place in Japanese Buddhism.
In this place where Kukai's prayers from 1,200 years ago still linger, you can enjoy a relaxing experience through the solemn temple complex, the mystical atmosphere of the sacred site Okunoin, and a stay at a temple lodging.
In Kyoto, you can enjoy the beauty and delicacy of Japanese culture in the cityscape. In Takayama, you can experience the traditional wooden houses and simple mountain life, adding a gentle afterglow to your journey.  
This route, which emphasizes feeling rather than superficial sightseeing, is a luxurious journey that allows you to confront yourself. In the stillness, a deep sense of satisfaction resides.
short_description: Two-night temple stay at Koyasan, explore mystical Okunoin cemetery, and visit Shirakawago. 12-day spiritual tour through Tokyo, Kyoto, and Takayama.

title_en: From Sacred Mountains to Coastal Calm – Deluxe
subtitle_en: Faith & Tradition: Koyasan,Ise-Shima & Shirakawa-go Hotel Deluxe: Departures until November 2026
description_en:
The journey begins with Tokyo's vibrant cityscape. Then it continues to Kashikojima, a coastal area surrounded by the sea, where you can experience the gentle nature of Ise-Shima and savor fresh seafood.
In Kyoto and Nara, you will visit temples and shrines steeped in a thousand years of history, allowing you to experience a moment of connection with Japan's spiritual culture.
The highlight of the journey is Koyasan. Surrounded by lush green mountains, this sacred site offers a space filled with silence and prayer, where you can slowly calm your mind. Staying at the hotel and enjoying vegetarian cuisine, you will experience a time unlike your daily life.
Afterwards, you will enjoy the bustling atmosphere of Osaka and the traditional townscape of Takayama, and the journey will return to a rhythm that harmonizes with nature and human life. The balance of stillness and movement that lingers in your heart is the essence of this journey.
short_description: Koyasan temple stay with deluxe hotels: 15-day tour with Ise Grand Shrine, Ago Bay, and Shirakawago. Premium stays from Tokyo to Kyoto and Nara.

day_by_day.title: Visiting Ise, the Spiritual Heart of Japan
day_by_day.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel After breakfast, check out and send your large luggage to Kyoto. You can explore Kashikojima at your leisure. title_en: Culture, Peace & Spiritual Reflection – Deluxe
subtitle_en: Faith & Tradition: Koyasan,Miyajima & Shirakawa-go Hotel Deluxe: Departures until November 2026
description_en: Beginning with the modern glamour of Tokyo, you will experience a quiet sense of emotion as you encounter prayers for peace in Hiroshima. After experiencing the lively food culture and warm hospitality of Osaka, you will head to Koyasan, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, nestled deep in the mountains. At Koyasan, you will encounter solemn temples and moss-covered Okunoin, where you can find peace of mind. In this sacred space, far removed from everyday life, you can immerse yourself in the "time of prayer" that the Japanese people have cherished. As the journey continues to Kyoto and Takayama, you will experience the beauty of Japan's traditions and the wisdom of living in harmony with nature, further deepening the tranquility of the trip. This is a journey that blends modernity and tradition, bustling energy and tranquility, leaving a lasting sense of peace in your heart.

description_en: After kicking off your journey in Tokyo, head away from the hustle and bustle to Koyasan, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, a sacred place in Japanese Buddhism. In this place where Kukai's prayers from 1,200 years ago still linger, you can enjoy a relaxing experience through the solemn temple complex, the mystical atmosphere of the sacred site Okunoin, and a stay at a temple lodging. In Kyoto, you can enjoy the beauty and delicacy of Japanese culture in the cityscape. In Takayama, you can experience the traditional wooden houses and simple mountain life, adding a gentle afterglow to your journey. This route, which emphasizes feeling rather than superficial sightseeing, is a luxurious journey that allows you to confront yourself. In the stillness, a deep sense of satisfaction resides.

day_by_day.activities: Breakfast at the hotel Today, let’s head out to enjoy the beautiful cherry blossoms of Nara. Travel by Kintetsu train to Haibara, then continue by bus to Takami-no-Sato, a spectacular mountain garden surrounded by over 1,000 weeping cherry trees. During the spring bloom, the slopes are transformed into a sea of pink, with panoramic views of the surrounding mountains from the garden’s viewpoints. After enjoying the blossoms, return to Haibara and continue by Kintetsu Railway to Hasedera Temple. Known as the “Temple of Flowers,” Hasedera is a historic Buddhist temple surrounded by nature, with a beautiful temple complex built into the mountainside. Its long stairway, wooden Main Hall and seasonal flowers create a particularly atmospheric setting in spring. Return to Osaka by Kintetsu train.

title_en: Luxury Japan Journey: Ise-Shima Escape
subtitle_en: Sacred Shrines, Premium Wagyu & Japan's Iconic Hotels
description_en:
Join a luxury tour that connects Japan’s top hotels with amazing experiences. Start your trip in Tokyo, where you will stay at the best hotels. Savor a delicious meal at a famous Matsusaka beef restaurant, then relax at a luxury resort in Shima.
You will visit the Ise Grand Shrine and travel in style on the Sightseeing Limited Express "SHIMAKAZE". Your journey also includes stays that let you enjoy the history, culture, and beauty of Kyoto and Kanazawa.
This travel plan is designed for adults who appreciate fine experiences. It carefully organizes all aspects of your trip, including transportation, places to stay, dining, and cultural activities.

title_en: Refined Kansai Journey: Lake Biwa & Castles
subtitle_en: A Premium Journey Through Shiga's Hidden Gems
description_en: Enjoy a premium journey across Japan, combining seamless Shinkansen travel with private sightseeing taxis for a comfortable and refined experience. Stay at high-end hotels, travel in the spacious comfort of Green Car (the first-class carriages on Japan's trains), and explore each destination with the ease of a dedicated vehicle. This tour takes you beyond the usual routes to discover some of Japan's lesser-known yet remarkable destinations. Visit Hikone Castle, a designated national treasure, stroll through the historic merchant town of Omihachiman, enjoy a cruise on Lake Biwa, and experience the serene moss gardens of Sanzen-in Temple in Ohara, Kyoto. Alongside these hidden gems, you will also have plenty of time to explore Japan's iconic cities, including Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka. This carefully designed route offers the perfect balance of cultural heritage, natural beauty, and vibrant city life — bringing together the best of both traditional and modern Japan in one unforgettable journey.
short_description: Cruise Lake Biwa, visit National Treasure Hikone Castle, Uji, Fusimi Inari Shrine. 11-day luxury tour with private taxis and Green Car Shinkansen.

title_en: Luxury Journey, Your Way: Hiroshima & Kyoto
subtitle_en: Private Tours, Green Car Travel & World Heritage Wonders
description_en:
This premium tour starts with a Shinkansen ride from Tokyo to Hiroshima. You will visit the Peace Memorial Park and the Atomic Bomb Dome to learn about important historical events. On Miyajima, you can explore the Itsukushima Shrine, which appears to float in the sea, before heading to Kyoto.
In Kyoto, you will see well-known sites like Kiyomizu-dera, Gion, Arashiyama, and Kinkaku-ji. You will also visit meaningful places such as Enryaku-ji on Mount Hiei, Sanzen-in in Ohara, and Byodo-in in Uji, all in a chartered taxi. This Japanese cultural experience is designed for mature travelers, connecting history, faith, and beautiful scenery.

title_en: Alpine Wonders of Central Japan
subtitle_en: Alpine Peaks Meet Ancient Streets: Departures from June to October
description_en:
This nature route takes you through the beautiful landscapes of central Japan, including Mount Fuji, the Japanese Alps, lakes, and highlands. 
You will start in Tokyo and see changing scenery every day. You'll explore the foothills of Mount Fuji, the highlands of Shinshu, and the clear streams of Kamikochi. You will also visit the mountain villages of Hida Takayama and Shirakawa-go. 
The journey includes stays at hot spring resorts and mountain hotels, allowing you to enjoy both nature and culture at a comfortable pace. 
In the later part of the trip, you'll cross the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route, known for its amazing mountain views. This loop combines natural beauty with comfort, helping you experience the true essence of Japan's land.

description_en:
This itinerary offers a nice mix of nature and culture. It takes you through the beautiful Japanese Alps and into historic cities in the Hokuriku and Kansai regions.
You will start in Tokyo and travel through Nagano. Then, you will cross the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route and enjoy the stunning mountain views and fresh air. After that, you can explore Japan's famous cultural cities: Toyama, Kanazawa, Kyoto, Nara, and Osaka.
This plan combines the Alpine Route—where the journey is part of the experience—with time to enjoy gardens, museums, and temples, as well as to walk through lively cities. You can appreciate both nature and city life at a relaxed pace. This itinerary is suitable for everyone, from first-time visitors to those who have been to Japan before, providing an enjoyable experience for all.

description_en: Discover the perfect harmony of nature and culture on this journey through some of Japan's most sacred sites and stunning coastal landscapes. In addition to visiting popular cities such as Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka, you'll explore spiritual landmarks including Ise Jingu Shrine and the Kumano Sanzan, both deeply rooted in Japan's history and religious traditions. In Shima, savor fresh local seafood at a traditional Ama hut while experiencing the region's unique coastal culture. Admire the dramatic beauty of Nachi Falls and the breathtaking scenery of the Kii Peninsula, where nature and history come together. This leisurely itinerary offers a memorable way to experience the rich history, culture, and natural beauty of Japan.

title_en: Alpine Wonders of Central Japan
subtitle_en: Spring-Only Spectacle: Tateyama Snow Wall - April & May 2027
description_en:
This nature course lasts about 1 month and lets you experience Snow Wall, a highlight of the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route in spring.
You will travel through famous landscapes like Mount Fuji, Kamikochi, and the Japanese Alps. The journey ends with a stunning experience: walking through a snow wall several meters high.
This itinerary combines the exciting mountainous areas with the calm beauty of lakes and highlands, plus the relaxation of hot springs. You can fully enjoy the unique aspects of Japan that spring offers.
This is an excellent Alpine Route experience for those who want to feel the scale and power of nature during this season.
*The Tateyama Snow Wall is a seasonal landscape visible for about one month, typically from April to May each year.

The park also has nature trails where you can enjoy seasonal plants, streams, and the forest's beauty. This makes it a great spot to connect with both wildlife and nature. After your visit, take the limited express train from Yudanaka to Nagano. You have two sightseeing options: Plan A and Plan B. title_en: Alpine Routes & Cultural Japan
subtitle_en: Spring-Only Spectacle: Tateyama Snow Wall - April & May 2027
description_en:
This tour combines nature and culture. It features a scenic mountain route through the Japanese Alps and visits historic cities in the Hokuriku and Kansai regions.
The main attraction is the "Snow Wall" on the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route, which you can only see in spring. Walking between snow walls over ten meters tall is a unique experience and the highlight of this trip.
You will travel from Tokyo through Nagano, crossing the Alpine Route and enjoying beautiful views at Murodo and Mikurigaike. You can also explore Japan's cultural cities: Toyama, Kanazawa, Kyoto, Nara, and Osaka.
This spring-only route lets you experience the impressive snow wall and stunning mountain scenery, along with gardens, temples, shrines, and city strolls. It offers a perfect mix of nature and urban life.
short_description: Experience the spring-only Yuki-no-Otani snow corridor on the Tateyama Alpine Route, and explore Matsumoto, Kanazawa & Kyoto. Spring-only 11-day tour.

title_en: Artful Setouchi & Japan's Timeless Hot Springs
subtitle_en: Setouchi Island Hopping
description_en:
Enjoy a 12-day trip to the Seto Inland Sea. Visit Mount Konpira in Kotohira, then relax in the beautiful nature of Iya Valley and Oboke. 
Explore the islands of Shodoshima, Naoshima, and Teshima in Takamatsu. Walk through the historic streets of Okayama and Kurashiki, and don’t miss Himeji Castle. 
End your journey by unwinding in the hot springs of Kinosaki Onsen. This trip provides a fantastic experience of the Seto Inland Sea and its famous hot springs.

title_en: Setouchi Shores & Shikoku Heartlands
subtitle_en: Setouchi Island Hopping
description_en:
Experience a 14-night, 15-day journey through the Seto Inland Sea and Shikoku.
Start in the tranquil port town of Tomonoura, then visit  Itsukushima Shrine, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, offers an atmosphere of spiritual in Hiroshima. Enjoy stunning views from Senkoji Temple in Onomichi and explore Kurashiki's Bikan Historical Quarter before heading to Takamatsu. Visit the islands of Naoshima, Teshima, and Shodoshima, and see the beautiful Ritsurin Garden. At Kotohira, visit Konpira Shrine, and take the bus tour through the Iya Valley and Oboke. Conclude your journey in Osaka. This itinerary highlights the best of the Seto Inland Sea and Shikoku for a memorable travel experience.
short_description: Island-hop through Setouchi's famous art islands, explore hidden gems like Tomonoura and Onomichi,and unwind in hot spring ryokans.15-day self-guided tour.

title_en: Setouchi Sea Paths & Historic Port Towns
subtitle_en: Setouchi Island Hopping
description_en: This loop course begins in Tokyo and heads west through the port towns and islands of the Seto Inland Sea. You will first visit Onomichi with its hilly streets, then Tomonoura, a historic port town. Next, you'll reach Hiroshima and the Peace Memorial area, followed by Miyajima, famous for its floating shrine. description_en: This circular tour explores the tranquil Seto Inland Sea's natural beauty, contemporary art, and historic castle towns. Starting from Tokyo, visit Kurashiki's white-walled district and Okayama Korakuen Garden. Based in Takamatsu, discover art island Naoshima and experience contemporary art harmonizing with nature. This ski tour includes a total of four nights in Tokyo and visits to Appi Ski Resort and Zao Ski Resort.
Appi Kogen in Hachimantai City, Iwate Prefecture, is one of Tohoku’s largest snow resorts, offering 21 courses including a long run of up to 5.5 km, along with powder snow and tree runs. After skiing, enjoy dining at the hotel restaurant and relax in the large bath.

This winter tour focuses on skiing in Hakuba, a well-known ski area in Japan, while also visiting its popular tourist spots. It starts with a chance to see wild monkeys in hot springs—a rare and exciting sight in the snow. Then you will have three days to ski freely in Hakuba, the prime skiing destination.
Next, the tour takes you to Kanazawa, a city full of history and culture, and then to Kyoto, Japan's ancient capital. You will also visit the hot spring resort of Hakone. The tour includes ski gear rental, so you won't need to carry heavy equipment. There is also a luggage delivery service for intercity transfers, making your travel easier and more comfortable.

title_en: Japan Winter Journey with Ski and Cities
subtitle_en: Gear Included for Easy Skiing
description_en:
This winter tour is perfect for enjoying skiing, soaking in Japanese hot springs, and exploring historic towns. First, you will visit Nagano, where you can see the famous wild monkeys bathing in hot springs surrounded by snow. Afterwards, you will stay at Yudanaka Onsen and spend a day skiing at Shiga Kogen Ski Resort. Your transportation to the ski resort is included for a stress-free experience.
Next, you will explore Takayama, an old town that still has its Edo-period charm. You will also visit Shirakawa-go, a village recognized as a World Heritage site for its thatched-roof gassho-zukuri houses. A taxi will take you around to enjoy the beautiful winter scenery showcasing Japan's traditional landscapes.
To make your trip easier, we include ski gear rental, so you don’t have to carry it. We also offer parcel delivery services for transfers between cities, allowing you to travel comfortably. This ski trip combines fun snow activities with Japanese culture and is suitable for beginners.

day_by_day.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel This vibrant city beautifully blends traditional Japanese culture with the latest trends. The best way to experience all that Tokyo has to offer is by exploring on foot, so put on your walking shoes and get ready for an adventure!

day_by_day.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel After breakfast, check out and send your large luggage to Osaka. You can explore Nagoya and Kashikojima at your leisure. In the morning, travel from Tokyo to Nagoya by Shinkansen. Nagoya is a beautiful city full of samurai history and unique food. Enjoy sightseeing in Nagoya! Hotel Check-in

day_by_day.title: Toba's Ama diving culture and the delicious seafood
day_by_day.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel Hotel Check-out In the morning, travel from Nagoya to Toba by Sightseeing Limited Express "SHIMAKAZE" or another limited express train. Toba is a port town in Mie Prefecture. It is known for its beautiful sea and island views and for its Ama diving culture. From Toba, take the shuttle bus to Hachiman Kamado. Hachiman Kamado is an Ama hut where you can enjoy a meal while Ama divers share stories about their fishing experiences and lives. You will enjoy delicious Ise seafood for lunch! After lunch, take the shuttle bus back to Toba, then travel from Toba to Kashikojima by limited express train. Hotel Check-in Dinner at the Hotel

day_by_day.title: History, Views, and Food in Osaka
day_by_day.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel Osaka is lively, with busy neighborhoods and a rich food culture. Enjoy sightseeing in Osaka!

day_by_day.title: Day trip to Koyasan, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and the spiritual center of Shingon Buddhism
day_by_day.activities: Breakfast at the Hotel In the morning, move to Koyasan by limited express train. Koyasan is a mountain town recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is surrounded by cedar forests and has deep ties to Japanese Buddhism. Kobo Daishi Kukai practiced asceticism here for over 1,200 years. In the evening, return to Osaka by limited express train.

day_by_day.title: Discovering the Timeless Charm of Nara and transfer to Kyoto

In the morning, travel from Osaka to Nara by Sightseeing Limited Express "AONIYOSHI", or another limited express train. Nara is one of Japan's oldest cultural centers, filled with ancient temples, historic shrines, and peaceful parks. Enjoy sightseeing in Nara! Transfer to Kyoto by limited express train. description_en:
After kicking off your journey in Tokyo, head away from the hustle and bustle to Koyasan, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, a sacred place in Japanese Buddhism.
In this place where Kukai's prayers from 1,200 years ago still linger, you can enjoy a relaxing experience through the solemn temple complex, the mystical atmosphere of the sacred site Okunoin, and a stay at a temple lodging.
In Kyoto, you can enjoy the beauty and delicacy of Japanese culture in the cityscape. In Takayama, you can experience the traditional wooden houses and simple mountain life, adding a gentle afterglow to your journey.  
This route, which emphasizes feeling rather than superficial sightseeing, is a luxurious journey that allows you to confront yourself. In the stillness, a deep sense of satisfaction resides.

Begin your trip in energetic Tokyo, then move to Kansai for an unforgettable entertainment experience at the theme park in Universal City, Osaka.
